pain_points.title: Loss of communication or computer access during ordinary daily use
pain_points.stakes: Loss of independence and communication continuity.
pain_points.design_response: Preserve usable access through explicit degradation, recovery and alternative input; measure useful independent task time.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Unintended commands during idle or ambiguous transitions
pain_points.design_response: Explicit no-command state, engagement, veto and consequence-dependent commit rules.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Session, device, montage or preprocessing shift
pain_points.stakes: Silent loss of decoding validity and calibration.
pain_points.design_response: Identity-bound qualification, drift diagnosis, expiry, bounded recalibration and rollback.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Sensor or timestamp faults mistaken for valid intent
pain_points.stakes: High-confidence action on unsuitable or stale observations.
pain_points.design_response: Finite data, channel-specific hard exclusions, timing bounds and decoder-required channel contracts.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Caregiver, setup, correction and support burden
pain_points.stakes: A technically functioning system may remain unusable.
pain_points.design_response: Accessible setup/recovery, versioned profiles, understandable failure states and burden metrics.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Machine assistance overrides or misrepresents the person
pain_points.stakes: Wrong goal, unwanted speech or unauthorized external commitment.
pain_points.design_response: User-selected assistance scope, proposal/approval separation, exact commit identity and correction.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Unstable or contaminated adaptation
pain_points.stakes: Feedback loops, semantic inversion, forgetting or repeated-holdout overfitting.
pain_points.design_response: Separate learning and control timescales; shadow, label provenance, locked audit data and rollback.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Fallback selected too late or unsuitable for the plant
pain_points.stakes: Withholding a new command may not stop ongoing motion.
pain_points.design_response: Model recoverability, deadline/uncertainty bounds and an independently supervised baseline controller.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Incomplete replay, asynchronous feedback or crash recovery
pain_points.stakes: Unexplained behavior, wrong learning consequence, duplicate external effects.
pain_points.design_response: Versioned capsules, pre-dispatch/outcome records, pending feedback and idempotent endpoint recovery.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Evaluation leakage and misleading generalization claims
pain_points.stakes: A convincing benchmark may fail on a new person or session.
pain_points.design_response: Group before epoching, lock splits, quantify clustered uncertainty and distinguish evidence levels.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Neural privacy and sensitive content exposure
pain_points.stakes: Unauthorized recording, interpretation, output or transfer.
pain_points.design_response: Explicit privacy modes, output lock, local processing and content retention controls.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Malicious or compromised model, worker or data path
pain_points.stakes: Unauthorized actuation or corrupted scientific evidence.
pain_points.design_response: Typed bounded IPC, isolated proposal workers, artifact verification, revocation and limited threat claims.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Compute, power or network limits destroy availability
pain_points.stakes: Useful access fails during overload, disconnection or unsupported model scaling.
pain_points.design_response: Local compact baseline, bounded queues, cancellation, explicit resource profiles and no required cloud path.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Evidence expiry as abilities, preferences and deployment change
pain_points.stakes: An old successful qualification is misapplied indefinitely.
pain_points.design_response: Versioned user profiles and dependency invalidation; continuation/support and export design.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.

pain_points.title: Ambition exceeds what software can establish
pain_points.stakes: Unsupported physiological, clinical, novelty or physical safety promises.
pain_points.design_response: Explicit external-evidence gates and cohort/modality/plant limits; do not disguise absence as performance.
pain_points.ranking_basis: Engineering judgment based on consequence, evidence, and software tractability; not a measured prevalence ranking.
